layout_notes: One teaching unit = one day. A lesson page holds exactly one day.

Top of a lesson page: a row of six tabs 'दिवस 1' … 'दिवस 6'. The CURRENT day is the tab drawn in a darker/stronger fill with dark text; the other five tabs are pale with grey text. Key 'day' = the number on the highlighted tab. Below the tabs a green band prints 'सप्ताह-N': key 'week' = N.
If no tab is highlighted or the band is missing, set the key to null and explain; do not infer from page order.

Body: numbered period bars in colour, e.g. '1. मौखिक भाषा विकास एवं लेखन ⏱ 30 मिनट' (level-1 section, number '1', minutes '30'). Inside, step bars '1.1 कविता/बालगीत गाना ⏱ 5 मिनट' (level-2 section). Items under a step are lines starting with '>' (type bullet) or plain text lines (type text, e.g. a bold line such as 'दिवस 1-2 पाठ्यपुस्तक रागिनी भाग 1 पृष्ठ 24 से पठन').
Reading order: the left column top to bottom, then the right column top to bottom. Periods may continue from the left column into the right one.

The box titled 'बहुकक्षा शिक्षण हेतु पाठ योजना' at the bottom is multigrade guidance: put it in 'shared' as one section with that heading. Inside it, make one sub-section per time row (heading = the printed minutes text like '(30 मिनट)', minutes = '30'); inside each row, sub-sections headed by the printed group label ('कक्षा 1 और कक्षा 2 साथ में', 'कक्षा 1', 'कक्षा 2') holding the bullet items.

Week-level pages (weekly plan/overview, assessment or review week pages, remedial plans) that do not show the six day tabs are page_kind 'plan', 'assessment' or 'back_matter'; still transcribe their content into 'shared' so nothing is lost.

Balvatika (pre-primary) pages use the same keys in a smaller form: 'सप्ताह – N' printed top-left (key week = N) and a small box of six tabs 'दिवस 1' … 'दिवस 6' below it where the CURRENT day's tab is darker/bold. The line 'दिनांक … हस्ताक्षर …' is a blank form field: ignore it. The box 'आज के लिए तैयारी सामग्री' (materials to prepare) is the unit's first section (number null, heading as printed, bullet items). A line printed beside a target icon inside a step is the step's aim: give it as the first item, type 'text'.
A page may be the start of a Balvatika/level section (cover or title page such as 'बालवाटिका-3 कार्यक्रम … भाग-2 सप्ताह 11 से 24 तक'): page_kind 'front_matter', and copy the title lines into 'notes'.
